text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Taiki... Perfect timing.
I was just looking for a training partner—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Just what the ship ordered!
How about we go chow down at an Italian restaurant afterwards?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, girl!
Why the long face, huh?
Let's hurry to the course and tear it up!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
W-What's wrong...?
You're not acting like your usual self, Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sharp! Looks like you figured it out, Suzuka-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I've been doing secret lessons with Taiki-chan lately.
She's totally on fire right now.
Her speed is on a whole 'nother level compared to before!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-is that so...?
Speed aside, it feels like she's been influenced
in a completely different way...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu... While doing lessons together, it seems all that trendy, youthful lingo has rubbed off on you, and now you're totally flashy and groovy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Right now, my speed and sense are totally fab! Come on, Suzuka! Let's-a-go to the track!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! Thanks to my lessons, my condition is tip-top!
Now, let's have a fair and square trio duel!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, let's hurry and run.
My head's starting to spin a bit..."
